newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pan United, Belgium firm in China deal.
newsitem.headline: Pan United, Belgium firm in China deal.

text.p: Belgium-based forest products specialist Westerlund Corp will invest $17 million in Changshu Port City to develop a logistics and distribution centre in China's Jiangsu Province for the paper and pulp industry, Singapore Changshu Development Co said on Tuesday.

It said in a statement that Westerlund and Changshu Xinghua Changjiang Development Co Ltd (CXC) signed a joint venture agreement in Brussels for the project. Westerlund and CXC hold 75 percent and 25 percent of the venture respectively.
CXC is a joint venture between a Singapore consortium led by shipping group Pan-United Corp Ltd and the Changshu local goverment.

The Westerlund facility will initially occupy five hectares at the port city, with provision to expand to 20 hectares. It will use a warehouse and multipurpose berths to handle forest products and break bulk cargo, the statement said.
